_comment: Rule-liveness ratchet baseline (tools/raman_saab/rule_liveness.py over the golden corpus). never_fired / yogas_never are the counts that MUST NOT INCREASE. Adding a rule no golden exercises, or breaking one so it stops firing, raises the count and fails test_rule_liveness. Fixing/covering rules lowers it -> re-baseline down.
